plugins.name: ai.nvim
plugins.description: Provider-agnostic AI layer for Neovim: streaming ask/chat, context assembly, and a Neovim-native UI on top of lib.nvim

plugins.name: buffer-ctx.nvim
plugins.description: Buffer context for Neovim — insert or copy path, module, timestamp, UUID, annotations, and boilerplate from the current buffer, plus a unified :Format and :Mark command tree. Requires lib.nvim for the command layer (notify/map/which-key integration stay optional).

plugins.name: cascade.nvim
plugins.description: Context-aware lists & word cycling for Neovim — continue, renumber, checkboxes, rotate, sort, indent/move, with native fallbacks. No Treesitter, standalone.

plugins.name: replacer.nvim
plugins.description: Project-wide search-and-replace with ripgrep, an interactive picker (fzf-lua or Telescope), live preview, and precise, bottom-up application of changes.

plugins.name: emojis.nvim
plugins.description: Remove, count, list, replace, or insert emojis in Neovim across line/visual/buffer/project scopes.

plugins.name: language.nvim
plugins.description: Spelling, grammar, and translation tooling for Neovim: one plugin, unified scope model, async throughout

plugins.name: markdown.nvim
plugins.description: Self-contained Markdown toolkit for Neovim — heading nav/shift, TOC, folding, GFM tables, link/anchor/image handling, and highlight fixes. FileType-scoped, no external tools.

plugins.name: data.nvim
plugins.description: Format and filter JSON/YAML/XML in Neovim: pretty/compact/lines/keys, buffer/selection/register scope.

plugins.name: migrate.nvim
plugins.description: Migrate deprecated Neovim API calls (nvim_*_option, vim.notify) in place — line, range, buffer, or cwd, with a Telescope picker.

plugins.name: gopath.nvim
plugins.description: A modular file-navigation plugin for Neovim. Resolves symbols, require() paths, and arbitrary file references via a multi-phase pipeline: LSP -> Treesitter -> whole-line extraction -> suffix search -> fuzzy alternate.

plugins.name: hover.nvim
plugins.description: Rest the cursor on a path or link and see what it points at: file heads, directory listings, images, PDF pages, markdown sections, URL details -- with every preview class an opt-in switch.

plugins.name: open.nvim
plugins.description: Open files, URLs, and paths from anywhere in Neovim — to the system default app, browser, file manager, or a split/tab.

plugins.name: pickers.nvim
plugins.description: Unified fuzzy-picker plugin for Neovim — one :Pickers command over telescope.nvim or fzf-lua, with scopes, collections and directory navigation.

plugins.name: filetree.nvim
plugins.description: Adapter-agnostic filetree features for Neovim — one feature set across neo-tree, nvim-tree, netrw & more, opt-out by default.

plugins.name: fileops.nvim
plugins.description: Unified :File command for Neovim — create, rename, move, duplicate, delete, and cycle files via libuv, cross-platform, no shell.

plugins.name: sessions.nvim
plugins.description: Branch- and project-aware Neovim sessions, built on lib.nvim — save/restore/rename, statusline component, session picker

plugins.name: neotree-fs-refactor.nvim
plugins.description: Automatic require()/import reference updates for Neo-tree file renames and moves

plugins.name: dap.nvim
plugins.description: Config layer on top of nvim-dap: adapters & launch configs for 9 languages, batteries included

plugins.name: debugging.nvim
plugins.description: One :Debug command for every Neovim debugging tool

plugins.name: diff.nvim
plugins.description: Flexible :Diff command for Neovim — compare buffers, files, or the clipboard, side-by-side or inline, via vim.diff (no shell calls).

plugins.name: lsp.nvim
plugins.description: Umbrella plugin for a Neovim config's whole LSP setup: server registry, attach pipeline, formatter and diagnostics toggles, a declarative catalogue for every LSP keymap, and the LSP-adjacent plugins installed and wired through its own lazy.nvim pack.

plugins.name: insights.nvim
plugins.description: Project analysis for Neovim — symbol index, code metrics, file tree, imports, and compression in one unified command.

plugins.name: runtime-analysis.nvim
plugins.description: Runtime truth for Neovim plugins: an HTTP request runner, opt-in call/argument telemetry, and live package.loaded inspection, paired with documentation.nvim's static truth.

plugins.name: recommender.nvim
plugins.description: Analyzes the current Lua buffer for repeated dotted chains and suggests local alias declarations in an interactive floating window.

plugins.name: spotlight.nvim
plugins.description: Persistent multi-token highlighting for Neovim: spotlight any number of words, IDs, IPs or error codes in distinguishable colors — matchadd-based, so cost is independent of file size. Per-project persistence.

plugins.name: cmdlog.nvim
plugins.description: A lightweight Neovim plugin to interactively view, search, and reuse command-line mode (`:`) and shell history using Telescope with extras.

plugins.name: testing.nvim
plugins.description: Test runner and orchestration layer for Neovim plugins, built on lib.nvim (pre-alpha skeleton)

plugins.name: sandbox.nvim
plugins.description: Manage your containers (Podman, Docker, and more) directly from Neovim – with clean architecture, pluggable backends, and a TUI-native experience.

plugins.name: github_stats.nvim
plugins.description: Automatic collection and analysis of GitHub repository traffic statistics for Neovim, with an interactive dashboard, exports, and period comparisons.

plugins.name: reposcope.nvim
plugins.description: Search, preview, and clone GitHub, GitLab, and Codeberg repositories directly from inside Neovim. Modular, minimal, Telescope-inspired interface.

plugins.name: docmap.nvim
plugins.description: know your project — an interactive module map, drift checks that fail CI, and an in-editor browser for any repository.

plugins.name: gitsuite.nvim
plugins.description: One :Git command tree for everything git in Neovim -- own implementation where it pays off, thin adapters where it doesn't.

plugins.name: terminal.nvim
plugins.description: Named, per-project terminals in Neovim: toggle a float/split/tab, send text, run commands with quoted argv. Backends: native, WezTerm panes, tmux; status export and window navigation across the multiplexer.

plugins.name: ui.nvim
plugins.description: Statusline, tabline and theme layer for Neovim — the frame around the window. Planning stage.

plugins.name: color_my_ascii.nvim
plugins.description: A Neovim plugin for colorful highlighting of ASCII art in Markdown code blocks with automatic language detection, custom highlights, and predefined color schemes.

plugins.name: images.nvim
plugins.description: Show images inside Neovim via the iTerm2 protocol (OSC 1337) — hover, gallery, clipboard paste. Works on native Windows where Kitty-protocol plugins cannot.

plugins.name: mdview.nvim
plugins.description: Highly secure, high-performance browser-based Markdown preview for Neovim — Go relay server + Rust/WASM sanitized rendering, no Node.js required.

plugins.name: media.nvim
plugins.description: What is in this media file, and one picture of it -- ffprobe metadata and ffmpeg poster frames/contact sheets for Neovim

plugins.name: pdfport.nvim
plugins.description: Extract and display PDF content in Neovim via pluggable extraction backends (pdftotext, pdfplumber, marker, docling, Claude, Ollama) and renderers.

plugins.name: lib.nvim
plugins.description: Reusable Lua/Neovim helper library — a tested, dependency-free base for personal plugins (lazy.nvim).

native.name: docmap-desktop
native.description: know your project — a desktop workspace for documentation.nvim's module maps.

native.name: takt
native.description: Modulare Medien-Suite in Rust: Player, Live-Studio, Video-Editor und DAW auf gemeinsamem Kern
